observations.trace: The local profile validator requires stations at0 and1, matching ordered landmark counts, across endpoints -1 and1 and nonnegative thickness; those checks alone permit all-zero thicknesses. ProfileField interpolates the zeros. During actual construction, after triangulation and partitioning, validate_apices requires any zero-height point to be an isolated authored boundary apex with positive neighboring heights, and separately rejects all-zero triangles. Thus an all-zero profile reaching this guard cannot return a constructed solid through the selected path. Construction::new invokes the solid producer before PhysicalProperties::from_sources; the public design validate and codec encode/decode invoke Construction::new. Earlier triangulation or other validation may reject sooner.
observations.remaining: This is a scoped source disposition of Adler333/334/335 pending all-zero question, not a historical accepted finding. No recipe, triangulation, validator, constructor, physical calculation, codec or test ran. Other partially degenerate profiles and alternate producer paths remain open. The checked-in test source describes a zero-interior rejection but was not executed.

observations.contract: Composite bow and crossbow layer dimensions
observations.trace: The per-field dimensions routines bound optional horn, backing and sinew thicknesses by absolute world extent, and the ranged check compares their sum to a fraction of depth. Neither condition alone proves each optional layer is positive or even present. Composite bow and crossbow producers require the options and send each layer width to Solid::sweep, whose selected first guard rejects nonpositive width. The public design validate includes Construction::new; no accepted negative-layer product is established from the earlier validator alone.
observations.remaining: If an earlier producer or other guard fails first it may give a different reason; exact authoring inputs, optional-mode policy, full error ownership and alternate constructors remain open. No bow, crossbow, sweep, model or product ran.

observations.trace: Shape dispatch routes every enumerated manufacturing shape to an appropriate dimensions check; these are one phase before graph, ranged, melee and shield checks and model construction. Plate boundary.last().unwrap is preceded by boundary length3..64; stations[0] in profile is preceded by positions requiring at least two stations and matching endpoints. The source contains outside-test unwraps as a style concern, but these local cardinality guards do not support an ordinary empty-list panic.
observations.remaining: Other child bodies and full producer/native paths remain unread; do not generalize the selected guards into complete shape validation or 128-ratio upper bounds everywhere. No validator or product ran.
